title: Shepherds
summary: Shepherds cared for flocks by feeding, guarding, guiding, counting, and sometimes risking danger for the sheep.
background: Shepherd imagery runs throughout Scripture, describing both human leaders and the Lord’s own care. Jesus identifies Himself as the good shepherd who lays down His life for the sheep.
teachingHelp: When teaching shepherd imagery, do not reduce it to sentimentality. Include guidance, protection, provision, sacrifice, and accountability.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
